help:
You cannot see. Click your tongue: a wave of dots shows the walls for a moment. Blind creatures live here and they hear everything, so echo with care.

The game is one long way north through seven levels. Each level's exit door is on its far side. On level 7, a bridge over nothing, a star is waiting, and sometimes an artefact beside it. Take them and walk all the way back, out of the door you first came in by: the star is yours to spend in the shop, the artefact goes into your achievements. The doors only let you go forward until you hold the star; then only back. On the way home there are more creatures.

Power-ups lie in the levels: walk over them to take them. They last until you die. Dying starts the game again from the beginning.

On a computer

  • W A S D walk, mouse look, hold Shift to run (loud).
  • Space echolocates. Esc pauses. F switches to full screen.

On a phone or tablet

  • Left thumb: drag to walk; push past the dashed ring to run.
  • Right thumb: drag to look; tap the round ECHO button to echolocate.

Headphones help a lot: you can hear where things are.
pw_vest: Radioactivity hurts you 60% less, but you are heavier: you move 20% slower and tire 30% faster.
pw_adren: While something hunts you nearby, you run 25% faster.
pw_chalk: You leave a faint trail on the floor that shows up when you echo.
pw_ventro: Your echo starts 6 m in front of you (or at the wall in the way). Monsters go there, not to you.
pw_rico: Your echo bounces round three corners and stays a little longer.
pw_cloak: Stand still for 2 seconds and nothing can hear you breathe, however close it is.
pw_lens: Your echo only goes forwards, but twice as dense and 1.5x as far.
pw_whisk: Walls within about 2 m ahead of you glow faintly while you move, without a sound.
pw_eye: Signs and the exit answer your echo from further away.
pw_tremor: You feel footsteps: anything walking within 22 m leaves red rings on the floor, even through walls.
pw_pill: You see everything, as it really is.
pw_star: Carry it out of the door you came in by and it is yours for good: spend it in the shop.
pw_memory: Every wall your echo touches stays lit for good. Only your echo.
pw_guide: A green line on the floor always shows the way out.
pw_negative: Walls and corners echo onto each other all around you, all the time: you see the shape of the place without a sound.
pw_crown: You beat Echoloc. You see everything. In the shop: take every power-up and every artefact you have.
pw_soles: Your running steps are heard only half as far.
pw_steady: Being out of breath no longer blurs or scatters your echo.
pw_wide: You see more around you: 95 degrees instead of 75.
pw_lucky: One more power-up lies in every level after this one.
pw_thread: Each echo also shows the next stretch of the way out, in green, on the floor.
